contacts.list.description: Capture-required contract reservation: list bounded LinkedIn messaging participants with statistics only after current viewer binding, real conversation and message pagination, group attribution, completeness, and acknowledgement-free behavior are reviewed.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by the preceding reviewed conversation page

stats_scan_limit.description: Maximum reviewed messages scanned per contact and direction

feeds.read.description: Capture-required contract reservation: the LinkedIn home-feed query revision is known, but execution remains disabled until exact current variables and a bounded response projection are captured and reviewed.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by the preceding page

profiles.read.description: Observed contract: read one exact signed-in LinkedIn self profile page with target binding and an optional exact private My Network connection total.

profile_url.description: Exact public LinkedIn self profile URL

include_connections.description: Also read the signed-in account's exact private My Network connection total

organizations.read.description: Observed contract: read one exact LinkedIn company Page and bind its exact follower count through the target Company and FollowingState records embedded by the first-party server render.

organization_url.description: Exact public LinkedIn company Page URL

relationships.recommendations.read.description: Capture-required contract reservation: list one bounded page of LinkedIn recommended connections only after the exact viewer-bound collection, paging variables, and completeness projection are captured and reviewed.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by the preceding recommendations page

messaging.list.description: Capture-required contract reservation: list one bounded LinkedIn inbox page only after the current-account mailbox projection, registered query, paging, completeness, and acknowledgement-free behavior are recaptured and reviewed.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by the preceding page

messaging.read.description: Capture-required contract reservation: the LinkedIn message query revision is known, but execution remains disabled until exact current variables and acknowledgement-free response handling are captured and reviewed.

conversation_id.description: Exact opaque conversation identifier returned by messaging.list

cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by the preceding page

messaging.send.description: Capture-required contract reservation: send one confirmed LinkedIn message, optionally with one reviewed attachment, only after createMessage request and response bindings are captured and reviewed.
messaging.send.sideEffect: Sends one externally visible LinkedIn message to the exact confirmed conversation.

conversation_id.description: Exact opaque conversation identifier returned by messaging.list

media.description: Optional reviewed image, video, or document attachment

posts.read.description: Capture-required contract reservation: read one LinkedIn consumer-web post after its exact first-party post-detail query and bounded projection are captured and reviewed.

post_urn.description: Exact LinkedIn share or UGC-post URN

comments.read.description: Capture-required contract reservation: list one bounded page of comments for an exact LinkedIn post after the consumer-web collection request is captured and reviewed.

post_urn.description: Exact LinkedIn share or UGC-post URN

cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by the preceding page

articles.read.description: Capture-required contract reservation: list LinkedIn first-party article records only after a fresh capture proves exact author, article identity, and paging response bindings.

author_urn.description: Exact LinkedIn person or organization author URN

posts.publish.description: Publish one exact confirmed LinkedIn post with text and an optional single PNG through bounded ordered page staging and the current first-party image-registration/upload and post-create contracts, durably retain the accepted share URN, then independently read it back.
posts.publish.sideEffect: Publishes one externally visible LinkedIn post with the exact confirmed audience and content.

posts.repost.description: Capture-required contract reservation: create one confirmed LinkedIn repost after the exact repost mutation and returned post identity are captured and reviewed.
posts.repost.sideEffect: Creates one externally visible LinkedIn repost of the exact confirmed post.

post_urn.description: Exact LinkedIn share or UGC-post URN to repost

posts.quote.description: Capture-required contract reservation: publish one confirmed LinkedIn quote repost after its exact mutation and returned post identity are captured and reviewed.
posts.quote.sideEffect: Publishes one externally visible LinkedIn quote repost with the exact confirmed commentary.

post_urn.description: Exact LinkedIn share or UGC-post URN to quote

comments.create.description: Capture-required contract reservation: create one confirmed top-level LinkedIn comment after exact actor, post, and returned-comment bindings are captured and reviewed.
comments.create.sideEffect: Publishes one externally visible comment on the exact confirmed LinkedIn post.

post_urn.description: Exact LinkedIn share or UGC-post URN

replies.create.description: Capture-required contract reservation: create one confirmed LinkedIn comment reply after exact actor, root, parent, and returned-reply bindings are captured and reviewed.
replies.create.sideEffect: Publishes one externally visible reply to the exact confirmed LinkedIn comment.

post_urn.description: Exact root LinkedIn share or UGC-post URN

reactions.set.description: Capture-required contract reservation: set the exact desired LinkedIn reaction after reviewed create and delete mutations can bind the actor, target post, and resulting state.
reactions.set.sideEffect: Sets or clears the authenticated account's reaction on the exact confirmed LinkedIn post.

post_urn.description: Exact LinkedIn share or UGC-post URN

reaction.description: Exact desired reaction, or none to clear it

relationships.connect.description: Capture-required contract reservation: send one confirmed LinkedIn connection invitation only after the exact viewer, target profile, optional note, duplicate state, request, and response bindings are captured and reviewed.
relationships.connect.sideEffect: Sends one externally visible LinkedIn connection invitation to the exact confirmed profile.

target_profile_urn.description: Exact LinkedIn profile URN returned by a reviewed profile or recommendation read

articles.draft.save.description: Create or replace one private native LinkedIn Article draft from ArticleDraftDocument schemaVersion 2 with native quote blocks, ordered local inline images, alt text, captions, and either one local cover image or the exact existing replacement-draft cover using reviewed current-member-bound autosaves and unpublished readback.
articles.draft.save.sideEffect: Creates one private native LinkedIn Article draft with the confirmed cover, or replaces the exact confirmed existing private draft while either replacing or preserving its banner, plus the confirmed inline image bytes, alt text, and captions; it never publishes the draft.

document.description: Canonical JSON for ArticleDraftDocument schemaVersion 2; this reviewed LinkedIn contract supports bounded paragraphs, H1/H2 headings, native blockquotes, native HTTPS links, and ordered inline image blocks with required alt text and optional captions

draft_id.description: Optional exact existing private LinkedIn Article draft to replace in place

cover_image.description: Exact local JPEG, PNG, or WebP cover rendered only in LinkedIn's banner slot; required for create, optional on an exact replacement to preserve the existing banner

inline_images.description: Ordered plan-bound local image files referenced by document imageIndex

items.description: One exact JPEG, PNG, or WebP inline image

articles.publish.description: Capture-required contract reservation: publish one confirmed native LinkedIn article only after its draft, optional cover upload, and publish sequence is captured and response-bound.
articles.publish.sideEffect: Publishes one externally visible native LinkedIn article with the exact confirmed title, body, cover, and audience.
